verdicts.reason: A breaks the hero: the backdrop circle has moved up behind the text block while the shoe floats underneath it, no longer inside it. The FREE DELIVERY badge is stranded in the bottom-left corner, and a large dead area is left at the bottom. B keeps the shoe inside its circle and reads top to bottom, but its alignment is mixed: GROVE is centred, the headline and body are left-aligned, and the pills and CTA are pushed right. The pills sit cramped right under the body copy, and the CTA is jammed near the bottom edge.
